  PROBLEM: Single quotes around the `printf` format string do not prevent Bash from interpreting `\n`, so this is not a bug.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers independently verified that `printf` interprets escape sequences in the format string regardless of shell quoting, so the claimed literal `\n` corruption does not occur.

  WHY: Reviewers agreed this is a minor robustness gap rather than a correctness bug; the existing `_rewrite_ok` guard catches command failures, but there is no dedicated post-write check for the summary line.
